metadata.title: Hatee: What if ST status is challenged in the court? ? | हाटी का मामला कोर्ट में गया तो क्या होगा?
metadata.description: The central government has accorded ST status to the Hattee community in Himachal Pradesh. Now the bill to amend constitutional order has to be amended in the parliament. It should not be a problem for the government to get the bill cleared, looking at the present strength of the parties. But real challenge can come in the courts of law for the community. Because some scheduled casts in trans giri area are opposing this decision and already filed a petition in high court. We discussed this and other aspects of the isse with Mr Kundan Singh Shashtri, General Secretary of Kendriya Hattee Samiti.
